description: Search adoptable pets by ZIP, radius, species, breed, age, sex and size, look up animals by ID, or fetch rescue organizations. Works without an API key; an optional free RescueGroups key adds API-only fields and organization name search.

animalIds.description: RescueGroups animal IDs or animal page URLs, e.g. `22514067`.
animalIds.title: Animal IDs (mode=byAnimalIds)

apiKey.description: Optional free public RescueGroups.org API key. Leave empty to use the cookieless public pet-search pages. A key adds API-only fields (adoption fee, energy level, exact birth date, and more) and organization name search.
apiKey.title: API key (optional)

breed.description: Breed name filter (mode=search), e.g. `Labrador Retriever`. The cookieless source matches any breed in the animal's breed string (primary or secondary); with an optional API key the primary breed is matched exactly.
breed.title: Breed

goodWithCatsOnly.description: Only animals flagged as good with cats.
goodWithCatsOnly.title: Good with cats only

goodWithDogsOnly.description: Only animals flagged as good with dogs.
goodWithDogsOnly.title: Good with dogs only

goodWithKidsOnly.description: Only animals flagged as good with kids.
goodWithKidsOnly.title: Good with kids only

includeDetails.description: Open each animal's public detail page for shelter contact, description, photos and temperament flags. Turn off for a faster, lighter listing-only run. The optional API path always returns full details.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full animal details

mode.description: What to fetch: a pet search, specific animals by ID, or rescue organizations.
mode.title: Mode

needsFosterOnly.description: Only animals currently looking for a foster home.
needsFosterOnly.title: Needs foster only

orgQuery.description: Optional organization name filter. Name search needs the optional `apiKey`; a numeric ID or organization-page URL works without one (legacy `orgQuery` inputs are supported).
orgQuery.title: Organization name or ID (mode=orgSearch)

organizationIds.description: RescueGroups organization IDs, e.g. `6260` (the number in a pet photo URL).
organizationIds.title: Organization IDs (mode=orgSearch)

postalCode.description: Center point for a radius search (mode=search). Leave empty to search everywhere.
postalCode.title: ZIP / postal code

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around the postal code (mode=search). The source supports 25, 50, 100 and 200 miles; requests under 25 use 25, values between buckets round down, and requests above 200 use 200.
radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)

specialNeedsOnly.description: Only animals flagged as having special needs.
specialNeedsOnly.title: Special needs only

species.description: Species filter (mode=search). Pick (any species) to search every species.
species.title: Species

title: RescueGroups Scraper Input
